name: Bournville Cranberry
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Cocoa Butter (24%*), Cocoa Solids (18%*), Dried Sweetened Cranberries (11%) (Cranberries, Sugar), Almonds (7%*), Milk Solids, Emulsifiers (442, 476), Flavours (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances). Allergen Information: Contains Milk, Almonds. May Contain Other Tree Nuts, Soy. #50% dark refers to 50% Cocoa Solids in the chocolate mass
